```{r message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(SoupX)
library(dplyr)
library(DropletUtils)
library(Matrix)
```

```{r read in data and visualization}
exp <- readRDS("/cell.counts.rds") # path of the cell.counts.rds generated by dropEst

count_matrix<- exp$cm
dim(count_matrix)
total_counts <- colSums(count_matrix)
df <- data.frame(
  total_UMIs = sort(total_counts, decreasing = TRUE)
)
df<- df %>%
  arrange(desc(total_UMIs)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

ggplot(df, aes(x = rank, y = total_UMIs)) +
  geom_line(data = df, aes(group = 1), color = "grey70") + 
  geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Barcode rank", y = "Total UMIs") +
  theme_bw() +

  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

ggplot(df, aes(x = total_UMIs)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "UMI Count Distribution",
       x = "Total UMIs per droplet (log10)",
       y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
bcrank <- barcodeRanks(count_matrix)

head(bcrank)
print(metadata(bcrank))


plot(bcrank$rank, bcrank$total, 
     log = "xy", 
     xlab = "Rank", 
     ylab = "Total UMI count",
     main = "Barcode Rank Plot (DropletUtils)",
     pch = 16, cex = 0.3)


abline(h = metadata(bcrank)$knee, col = "dodgerblue", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
abline(h = metadata(bcrank)$inflection, col = "forestgreen", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("bottomleft", 
       legend = c("Knee", "Inflection"), 
       col = c("dodgerblue", "forestgreen"), 
       lty = 2, lwd = 2)

```

```{r}
set.seed(100)
e.out <- emptyDrops(count_matrix, 
                    lower = 300,      # Droplets below this value are used to estimate the background, so adjust the threshold based on the curve you have obtained
                    niters = 100000)   # Monte Carlo 模拟次数

head(e.out)

is.cell <- e.out$FDR <= 0.001  
sum(is.cell, na.rm = TRUE)  

table(Sig = is.cell, Limited = e.out$Limited)

plot(e.out$Total, -e.out$LogProb, col=ifelse(is.cell, "red", "black"),
    xlab="Total UMI count", ylab="-Log Probability")

plot_df <- data.frame(
  Total = e.out$Total,
  LogProb = e.out$LogProb,
  FDR = e.out$FDR,
  Cell = ifelse(is.na(e.out$FDR), "NA",
                ifelse(e.out$FDR <= 0.001, "Cell", "Empty"))
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Total, y = -LogProb, color = Cell)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cell" = "red", 
                                 "Empty" = "grey70", 
                                 "NA" = "black")) +
  labs(title = "EmptyDrops Results",
       x = "Total UMI count",
       y = "-Log Probability") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(plot_df[!is.na(plot_df$FDR), ], aes(x = FDR)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.001, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "FDR Distribution", x = "FDR", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

cell_barcodes <- which(e.out$FDR <= 0.001 & e.out$Total >= 500 & !is.na(e.out$Total)) # also adjust the threshold based on the curve you have obtained
filtered_matrix <- count_matrix[, cell_barcodes]

```

```{r SoupX}
toc <- filtered_matrix
tod <- exp$cm

#fast clustering for running soupX
coral_temp <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = toc, min.cells = 5)
coral_temp <- NormalizeData(coral_temp)
coral_temp <- FindVariableFeatures(coral_temp, nfeatures = 2000)
coral_temp <- ScaleData(coral_temp)
coral_temp <- RunPCA(coral_temp, npcs = 20)
coral_temp <- RunUMAP(coral_temp, dims = 1:20)
coral_temp <- FindNeighbors(coral_temp, dims = 1:10)
coral_temp <- FindClusters(coral_temp, resolution = 0.6)

clusters <- coral_temp$seurat_clusters
umap <- Embeddings(coral_temp, "umap")

#run SoupX
sc <- SoupChannel(tod, toc)
sc <- setClusters(sc, clusters)
sc <- setDR(sc, umap)

sc <- autoEstCont(sc)
print(paste("Estimated contamination fraction:", sc$fit$rhoEst))
head(sc$soupProfile[order(sc$soupProfile$est, decreasing = TRUE), ], 10)
corrected_counts <- adjustCounts(sc)
```

```{r corrected_analyze}
coral_corrected <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = corrected_counts, project = "coral_corrected")
coral_corrected
```

```{r}
mito_gene <- readLines("/coral_mito_gene.txt") # the path to the gene list of mito genes
mito_gene <- gsub("_", "-", mito_gene)
cat("线粒体基因数量：", length(mito_gene), "\n")
assay <- if ("RNA" %in% names(coral_corrected@assays)) "RNA" else DefaultAssay(coral_corrected)
features <- Features(coral_corrected[[assay]])
mito_gene_in_data <- intersect(mito_gene, features)

cat("在 Seurat 对象中找到的线粒体基因数量：", length(mito_gene_in_data), "\n")

coral_corrected <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  object  = coral_corrected,
  features = mito_gene_in_data,
  col.name = "percent.mito",
  assay    = assay
)
```

```{r}
Seurat::VlnPlot(coral_corrected, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mito"),assay = "RNA", layer = "counts",
  combine = FALSE, ncol = 3)
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(coral_corrected, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mito")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(coral_corrected, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2
```

```{r}
#Data normalization and dimension reduction
coral_corrected <- NormalizeData(coral_corrected, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
coral_corrected <- FindVariableFeatures(coral_corrected, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
all.genes <- rownames(coral_corrected)
coral_corrected <- ScaleData(coral_corrected, features = all.genes)
coral_corrected <- RunPCA(coral_corrected, features = VariableFeatures(object = coral_corrected),npcs = 20)
coral_corrected <- FindNeighbors(coral_corrected, dims = 1:10)
coral_corrected <- FindClusters(coral_corrected, resolution = 0.6)
coral_corrected <- RunUMAP(coral_corrected, dims = 1:20)
DimPlot(coral_corrected, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(DoubletFinder)
sweep.res.list_kidney <- paramSweep(coral_corrected, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats_kidney <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list_kidney, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn_kidney <- find.pK(sweep.stats_kidney)
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn_kidney$pK[bcmvn_kidney$BCmetric == max(bcmvn_kidney$BCmetric)]))
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(coral_corrected@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
nExp_poi <- round(0.1 * length(coral_corrected@meta.data$seurat_clusters)) 
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))
print(pK_value)
print(nExp_poi)
print(nExp_poi.adj)
pN_value <- 0.25
pANN_value <- paste0("pANN_", pN_value, "_", pK_value, "_", nExp_poi)
coral_corrected <- doubletFinder(coral_corrected, PCs = 1:10, pN = pN_value, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi)
pann_cols <- grep("^pANN", colnames(coral_corrected[[]]), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(pann_cols) > 0)
tail(pann_cols, 1)
coral_corrected <- doubletFinder(coral_corrected, PCs = 1:10, pN = pN_value, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = tail(pann_cols, 1))   
df_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(coral_corrected@meta.data), value = TRUE)
df_col <- tail(df_col, 1) 
coral_corrected@meta.data$Doublet <- coral_corrected@meta.data[[df_col]]
table(coral_corrected@meta.data$Doublet)
coral_corrected <- subset(coral_corrected, subset = Doublet == "Singlet")
```


```{r}
#Data normalization and dimension reduction
coral_corrected <- NormalizeData(coral_corrected, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
coral_corrected <- FindVariableFeatures(coral_corrected, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
all.genes <- rownames(coral_corrected)
coral_corrected <- ScaleData(coral_corrected, features = all.genes)
coral_corrected <- RunPCA(coral_corrected, features = VariableFeatures(object = coral_corrected),npcs = 20)
DimPlot(coral_corrected, reduction = "pca") + NoLegend()
coral_corrected <- RunUMAP(coral_corrected, dims = 1:20)
DimPlot(coral_corrected, reduction = "umap")
pca_embed <- Embeddings(coral_corrected, reduction = "pca")[, 1:20]
dup_cells <- duplicated(pca_embed)
coral_corrected_unique <- subset(coral_corrected, cells = colnames(coral_corrected)[!dup_cells])
coral_corrected_unique <- RunTSNE(coral_corrected_unique, dims = 1:20)
coral_corrected <- coral_corrected_unique
DimPlot(coral_corrected, reduction = "tsne")
#clustering
coral_corrected <- FindNeighbors(coral_corrected, dims = 1:10)
coral_corrected <- FindClusters(coral_corrected, resolution = 0.6)
DimPlot(coral_corrected, reduction = "tsne")
DimPlot(coral_corrected, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# extract UMI counts and cluster identities
cluster_umi <- data.frame(
  Cluster = Idents(coral_corrected),
  UMI = coral_corrected$nCount_RNA
)

# calculate summary statistics for each cluster
cluster_stats <- cluster_umi %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_UMI = mean(UMI),
    Median_UMI = median(UMI),
    Min_UMI = min(UMI),
    Max_UMI = max(UMI),
    SD_UMI = sd(UMI),
    Cell_Count = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cluster)

# output summary table
knitr::kable(cluster_stats, caption = "UMI in each cluster")

# violin plot for UMI distribution in each cluster
ggplot(cluster_umi, aes(x = factor(Cluster), y = UMI, fill = factor(Cluster))) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMIplot in each cluster", x = "Cluster", y = "UMI counts") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_y_log10()

```
